body:
_Migrated from issue #1217, filed 2026-07-29._

Splitting this out of #615 (French) so it's tracked on its own rather than expanding a locale-scoped fix.

## What

The new interface has **752** translatable strings. Coverage measured against the live-catalog semantics the app actually serves (`cps/api/i18n.py` — non-fuzzy, non-empty):

| locale | covered | % |
|---|---|---|
| ru | 751 | 99.9% |
| pt_BR | 443 | 58.9% |
| fr | 752 | 100% (fixed in #615) |
| hu | 197 | 26.2% |
| de | 176 | 23.4% |
| es | 82 | 10.9% |
| ja | 76 | 10.1% |
| nl | 76 | 10.1% |
| it | 74 | 9.8% |
| sl | 72 | 9.6% |
| zh_Hans_CN | 72 | 9.6% |
| ko | 71 | 9.4% |
| pl | 70 | 9.3% |
| ar | 66 | 8.8% |
| pt | 64 | 8.5% |
| sk | 64 | 8.5% |
| gl / id | 63 | 8.4% |
| zh_Hant_TW | 62 | 8.2% |
| sv | 60 | 8.0% |
| vi | 59 | 7.8% |
| el | 57 | 7.6% |
| cs | 56 | 7.4% |
| uk | 54 | 7.2% |
| fi | 49 | 6.5% |
| tr | 47 | 6.2% |
| no | 42 | 5.6% |
| km | 41 | 5.5% |

## Why it's invisible

The SPA's English source strings **are** the gettext msgids, so a missing translation falls back to the English key. Nothing raises, nothing logs, no placeholder renders. A user on a 7%-translated locale sees a mostly-English app and has no reason to think it's a bug rather than a design choice — which is why #615 arrived as one reporter patiently walking screen by screen.

## Not an extraction bug

Worth stating up front, because the obvious guess is wrong: extraction is healthy. 0 SPA msgids are missing from `messages.pot` and the #719 anchoring gate (`cps/spa_strings.py` + `scripts/extract_spa_strings.py`) holds. The catalogs were just never filled in for the new UI. `scripts/update_translations.sh` runs `msgmerge --no-fuzzy-matching` by design (#879), so new strings correctly land as empty reviewable entries — they simply stay empty.

## Scope notes

- Release-note copy (`data/whatsNew.ts`, ~20 strings) is out of scope. It's regenerated every release and the page says in its own body that update notes stay English.
- `test_spa_placeholders_survive_translation` (added in #1216) already covers all 28 locales and is currently clean, so any translations added here are protected against dropping a `{placeholder}` from day one.
- The hard coverage gate added in #1216 is French-only on purpose. Extending it per-locale should probably come *after* a locale is complete, otherwise it blocks every SPA string addition on 28 translations.

Reach-wise German (176) and pt_BR (443) are closest to done and likely the best next candidates.
title: New UI is largely untranslated in every language except Russian
